svg.text: CIS 591 · four teams, one forest, one fire. Hold the line.

rect.data-content: RIDGE 100% · PINE VALLEY 100% · CEDAR CREEK 100% · BIRCH HOLLOW 100%

svg.textArea:
Fire spreads every 20 s, faster downwind. Embers can jump a 1-wide firebreak. Wind turns every 5 min. Lightning strikes a few times: watch the banner.
Paint only your sector, after a teammate approves your PLAN. One paint per player every 5 s.
Water on fire, forest or cabin. Dries in 90 s. One shared pool for the whole class (count on the banner).
Firebreak on forest. Permanent.
Backburn: an approved run of up to 20 forest squares, painted burnt.
HELP: 2 players of another team may paint your sector for 3 min.
Approve a teammate's sticky: add a line YES or NO.
Score: forest + water + 10 per cabin, as % of the start. 30 min. Highest % wins.
Square borders show the sector. Fire starts at R17 S17 R18 S18.

rect.data-content: No players yet. /join to enter the fight.

g.textArea: Boss posts PLAN, ORDER · name, BACKBURN P6-P15 and STATUS here. HELP goes in a neighbour's frame. A teammate approves by adding a line YES or NO.

rect.data-content: EXAMPLE · a PLAN sticky looks like: PLAN hold the east edge with water, firebreak column P

/join Your Name creates your card here. The referee writes your team, role and every refusal on it.
